categories.main_business_segments: SK ie technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of Lithium-ion Battery Separators (LiBS), a key component in lithium-ion batteries that enhances battery safety by preventing direct contact between electrodes. The company also has a minor segment in new businesses including gas separation membranes and other related products. The FCW (Flexible Cover Window) business was reported for discontinuation in early 2024.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary LiBS production technologies including the world's first sequential stretching process and simultaneous double-sided coating technology. It produces ultra-thin films (down to 5μm) with high uniformity and strength, leveraging advanced coating and ceramic coating separator (CCS) lines. R&D is conducted in collaboration with SK Innovation’s research centers focusing on process innovation, product development, and commercialization of next-generation battery materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are battery manufacturers serving IT devices, power tools, electric vehicles (xEV), and energy storage systems (ESS). The company supplies high-quality separators tailored to global battery makers, including major clients in North America, Europe, and Asia. The EV market is a major growth driver, with increasing demand for high-performance separators to meet safety and performance requirements.
categories.geographic_coverage: SK ie technology operates production facilities in South Korea (Cheongju and Jeungpyeong), China (Changzhou), and Poland (Silesia). It serves global markets including North America, Europe, and Asia, with a strategic focus on expanding capacity in Poland to meet growing demand. The company also targets the North American market aggressively due to favorable policy environments and supply localization trends.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the lithium-ion battery supply chain as a key materials supplier producing battery separators, an essential intermediate component between cathode and anode. It supplies directly to battery cell manufacturers, positioning itself as a critical upstream materials provider supporting battery and EV industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening global leadership in LiBS through technology innovation, cost competitiveness, and global supply chain expansion. R&D focuses on ultra-thin, high-strength, low-resistance separators, ceramic-coated separators, and next-generation materials like nano-composite membranes and solid electrolytes. The company is also exploring new business opportunities in environmental membranes such as carbon capture and next-generation battery materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of lithium-ion battery separators to battery manufacturers worldwide. Sales are conducted via long-term supply contracts and direct shipments, with pricing confidential and contract-based. The company also earns royalties from intangible asset licensing related to separator technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global top-tier player in the LiBS market, competing with a small number of technologically advanced firms primarily from Korea, Japan, and China. It holds competitive advantages in proprietary production technologies, product quality uniformity, and global manufacturing footprint. Recent U.S. policy changes (IRA and Foreign Entity of Concern regulations) enhance its competitive position in North America relative to Chinese competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, SK ie technology reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 649.6 billion (about USD 550 million), with a 10.9% year-over-year growth and operating profit of KRW 32 billion, marking a return to profitability. Total assets reached KRW 4.08 trillion with a 59.1% equity ratio. The company is investing heavily in capacity expansion, especially in Poland, with CAPEX totaling around KRW 5 trillion over recent years, aiming to increase production capacity to 2.7 billion square meters by 2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior product quality, technological leadership in ultra-thin and ceramic-coated separators, and the ability to meet diverse customer specifications with high uniformity and reliability. Its global production sites enable localized supply to key markets, enhancing responsiveness and reducing risks. The integration of advanced R&D and production innovation supports cost competitiveness and sustainable growth, positioning it as a trusted partner for leading battery manufacturers.
